scope: Read-only secondary analysis of the completed 900 ordinary-GA knapsack runs; outcomes already inspected, hence exploratory and not a new confirmatory experiment.

source.artifact_rule: Only the 30 worker ZIPs in the frozen summary transport ledger; verify ZIP SHA256, file manifest, source provenance and all 900 unique identities; no replacement source, seed or regenerated search.

availability.neighbor_definition: All 100 single and 4950 unordered two-bit flips, including infeasible neighbors; only feasible strict profit increases count as improving.
availability.interpretation: Conditional probability of mutation of the same fixed record reaching an improving radius-two neighbor with no extra flips; not the probability of success of the complete GA and not a new GA parameter recommendation.
availability.sampling: Exact uniform sampling without replacement from all 5050 neighbors; no Monte Carlo or new random seeds.
availability.zero_better: Keep in every all-stagnant summary; detection probability zero does not describe sampling error when there is no improving radius-two neighbor.

operators.offline_reconstruction: Reconstruct selected parents and pre-mutation crossover masks from recorded operators; score with original integer weights/profits after search; no generated mask or diagnostic result is returned to search.
operators.reference: Feasible first-attainment record immediately before each evaluated final candidate, including earlier candidates in the same incomplete generation.
operators.event_definition: Pre-mutation and final candidate are compared independently with the same pre-query record. These four events are exhaustive and disjoint; lost concerns an unevaluated intermediate, never an evaluated final record discarded by selection.
additional: comparison with best feasible selected parent with explicit undefined denominator
record in committed population vs pending generation
operators.record_presence_warning: A record from the current generation can still be pending rather than missing due to survival selection; certificate of a record does not certify the whole population.

analysis.aggregation: Repeated runs then UC/WC/SC tasks then equal weights for ten sNNN families; conditional means are ratios of family-weighted numerator and denominator, not means of only selected tasks.
terminal_subsets: all 210 stagnant including eight without an improving neighbor
202 stagnant with an improving neighbor, explicitly conditional

spearman.units: Ten family means across all original runs, not candidates and not only selected stagnant runs

figures: Operator events and feasibility before/after mutation
Exact detection probability versus sample size
analysis.figure_style: No in-image titles; axes, units, data and legends only; captions outside images; zeros and empty categories shown numerically.
analysis.missing_source: Incomplete audit reported explicitly; never replace sources or claim all 900 analyzed.

execution.authorization: Separate explicit new authorization required before any CI job; unused previous grants are not transferred.
execution.accounting: Round each job duration up; include all attempts and service jobs; unknown use or insufficient remaining grant blocks execution.

forbidden: editing historical kernels, protocols, evidence or documents
claiming novelty of elementary probability formulas
completion: 900 unique source runs independently checked; all registered endpoints including zeros/UNDEFINED; source and new-stage provenance separated; three question-driven plots and a new local academic subsection. Scientific completion is not claimed before CI evidence exists.
